en.role: Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of Finance
en.quote: …Russia will soon attract heightened investor attention as an island of stability.
en.head: The RTS index fell 19% in one day.
en.body: On October 6, 2008, the RTS and MICEX indices fell by 19% and 18%. Russia’s GDP contracted by 7.9% in 2009, according to Rosstat. The dollar rose from 25.4 rubles in September 2008 to 34.8 in March 2009. Medvedev had earlier spoken of an “island of stability.”

notes: “Heightened investor attention” preserves the forecast’s sense without strengthening it; “island of stability” is rendered literally.
